name: Redis Caching & Distributed Systems
description: High-throughput caching architectures, pub/sub messaging, rate limiting, and distributed locking.
best_practices: Cache stampede mitigation: Use probabilistic early expiration (XFetch algorithm) or mutex locks to avoid thundering herds.
TTL policies: Define explicit TTLs on all keys with randomized jitter to prevent synchronized expiration.
Atomic Lua scripts: Encapsulate complex state transitions in Lua scripts or Redis Functions for atomic execution.
Eviction policy selection: Select appropriate maxmemory-policy (volatile-lru, allkeys-lfu) matching usage patterns.
Distributed locking: Implement Redlock with unique tokens and release verification via compare-and-delete Lua scripts.
